title: Illustration use / Infrastructure collage with text

location.series: Helsinki illustration examples — PDF derived from the official PowerPoint deck with LibreOffice

slide_intent: Group related fragments into a distinct image zone so a collage can accompany detailed text without fragmenting the reading path.
strategic_value: Construction and waterfront motifs can give Helsinki explanatory material a locally recognizable setting.
demonstration: A planter, white bridge on blue water, crane, buildings and small facade cluster at left; the right holds a heading and two paragraphs, with a small logo at lower left.
practical_value: Keep the collage concentrated beside a stable text column and use the logo as a separate signature.

content_islands.name: Infrastructure collage
content_islands.spec: Stack planter, bridge, crane and building fragments across the left half.

content_islands.name: Text column
content_islands.spec: Align the heading and two paragraphs at right.

content_islands.name: Logo signature
content_islands.spec: Place the small framed logo below the image field.

reference_purposes.Application: The slide applies infrastructure motifs beside a conventional text column.
reference_purposes.Expression: Orange crane, blue water and outlined buildings create a recognizable collage vocabulary.
